text: DEFONEOS — DWP Statutory Maternity Pay AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × STATUTORY MATERNITY PAY DWP Statutory Maternity Pay AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK Statutory Maternity Pay — employer liability, HMRC recovery, eligibility cascading, and maternal workplace protection. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Eligibility SMP Eligibility Cascade AI Continuous employment test (26 weeks to Qualifying Week). Earnings threshold verification (£123/week). Employment start date validation. Agency worker qualification under AWR 2010. Multiple employer aggregation rules. NI Class 1 contribution cross-match. Pregnancy notification protocol (28 days before QW). Stillbirth eligibility preservation (after 24 weeks). Employer Employer SMP Liability AI Employer-funded SMP for first 6 weeks at 90% Average Weekly Earnings. Statutory rate weeks 7–39 at £184.03/week. HMRC recovery via Employer Payment Summary (EPS). Small employer relief scheme (103% recovery rate). Cash flow impact modelling for SMEs. Payroll system integration (Sage, Xero, ADP). Multi-site employer aggregation. Group payroll consolidation across subsidiaries. Rates SMP Rates & Calculation AI Average Weekly Earnings computation from 8-week lookback. 90% AWE applied to first 6 weeks of SMP. Lower statutory rate (£184.03) applied weeks 7–39. Variable pay smoothing across irregular earnings. Bonus and commission inclusion rules. Overtime averaging over 8-week reference period. Shift pattern calculation for non-standard schedules. Part-year worker (term-time) adjustment methodology. HMRC HMRC Recovery & Compliance AI Employer Payment Summary (EPS) filing via RTI. Class 1 NIC compensation claim against SMP paid. Small employer recovery scheme eligibility and advance claims. Real Time Information cross-match verification. Late filing penalty avoidance workflows. Overpayment recovery from employee protocol. Employer compliance audit readiness. Payroll agent delegation and authorisation management. Workplace Maternal Workplace Protection AI Statutory redundancy protection from date of pregnancy notification until return. Return-to-work guarantee enforcement. Keeping In Touch (KIT) day tracking (10 days max). Health and safety workplace risk assessment for pregnant workers. Antenatal appointment paid time-off verification. Reasonable workplace adjustment protocol. Discrimination detection and early warning. Employment tribunal case preparation toolkit. Shared Parental SMP to SPL Conversion AI SMP curtailment notice for Shared Parental Leave opt-in. Birth partner eligibility verification (employment and earnings test). Shared parental pay (ShPP) calculation at £184.03/week. Employer notification processing within statutory deadlines. SPL booking system with block allocation. Mixed leave planning combining maternity and SPL. Pay period alignment across employer and DWP. Multiple SPL block management and continuity. Health Maternal Health Integration AI Antenatal care appointment tracking and paid time-off compliance. Mental health screening referral to perinatal services. Occupational health workplace assessment triggers. High-risk pregnancy modified duties protocol. Stillbirth and neonatal loss compassionate pathway. Postnatal return-to-work health assessment. NHS midwife and health visitor liaison. Domestic abuse safeguarding trigger and referral pathway. Fraud SMP Counter-Fraud AI HMRC RTI employment verification against declared employer. Multiple employer claim detection across PAYE references. Phantom employment creation detection. NI Class 1 contribution validation in real-time. Employer collusion risk scoring for fictitious maternity claims. Proportionate investigation with dignity protocol. No blanket investigations
